en.headline: Fitness coach jailed nine months for Admiralty MTR bomb threat in online game
en.dek: A 31-year-old man was sentenced at Eastern Magistrates' Courts on Friday after messages sent during a League of Legends match threatened to explode Admiralty station on Lunar New Year's Day.
body: Magistrate Gary Chu Man-hon sentenced Chung Chi-long to nine months' imprisonment on Friday after finding him guilty of one count of threatening to destroy or damage property. The court heard that on 27 January Chung sent three successive messages during a League of Legends match warning that he was preparing to blow up the subway on the first day of the Lunar New Year, specifying Admiralty station and telling the recipient to remember to watch the news.

Chung had pleaded not guilty. He told the court the messages were an unthinking burst of anger after verbal provocation from another player and that no one would take game chat seriously. The magistrate rejected that account, noting the sequential and coherent nature of the threats, the specific date and location, and the short interval between messages, which showed deliberate thought rather than pure impulse.

The magistrate highlighted that Admiralty is a major interchange connecting Hong Kong Island, Kowloon and the New Territories and that a threat of an explosion there on a public holiday risked widespread panic. Police searches of the station and Chung's home found no explosives or related materials. Chung, who previously worked as a hospital patient care assistant and is now a part-time fitness coach, applied for bail pending appeal but was refused.

zh.headline: 兼職健身教練網遊揚言年初一炸金鐘站 罪成判囚9個月
zh.dek: 東區裁判法院周五裁定31歲男子一項威脅摧毀或損壞財產罪成，判囚9個月。他在《英雄聯盟》對戰期間發出訊息，揚言農曆新年初一在金鐘站放炸彈。
body: 裁判官朱文瀚周五判處鍾智朗監禁9個月。案情指，鍾於今年1月27日在《英雄聯盟》對戰期間，連續發出三則訊息，稱準備在年初一炸地鐵，並指定金鐘站，又叫對方記得看新聞。
鍾否認控罪，辯稱訊息是遭對方言語挑釁後情緒激動下的「連珠炮發」，打機時的說話不會有人當真。裁判官不接納其說法，指三則訊息前後連貫、提及具體日期和地點，相隔僅數十秒，顯示經過思考而非胡言亂語。
裁判官強調金鐘站是連接港島、九龍及新界的主要轉車站，在公眾假期作出爆炸威脅可能引起廣泛恐慌，屬加刑因素。警方其後搜查金鐘站及鍾的住所，均未發現炸彈或相關物品。鍾曾為醫院病人服務助理，現職兼職健身教練；他申請保釋等候上訴被拒。
